title: identity.v1 — the signed identity the gateway forwards to the services behind it
description: The gateway resolves a bearer through identity's /internal/validate and forwards the request with X-Vexa-Identity: "v1." + base64url(claims JSON) + "." + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(VEXA_GATEWAY_IDENTITY_SECRET, "v1." + base64url(claims JSON))). agent-api and meeting-api verify the signature in constant time, the issue time and the expiry within a bounded clock skew, and rebuild every x-user-* header from these claims. A request that asserts an x-user-* header without a valid signature, and without the internal tier's X-Internal-Secret, is refused with 401.

sub.description: the user id identity resolved; becomes x-user-id

email.description: the verified email identity holds; becomes x-user-email

exp.description: expires at, unix seconds; a verifier refuses exp - iat > 300

Delegation.description: Present when the bearer was a worker's delegation token (vxd_). The ceiling the dispatch granted: a service refuses a person-in-the-loop verb when regime is not human.

workspaces.description: "*" (everything already the subject's) or the isolation set; becomes x-user-delegation-workspaces

target.description: the chat's target workspace, a default and never a grant; becomes x-user-delegation-target

Vector.description: A signing test vector: any implementation signing these claims at `now` with `secret` must produce `token`.
